params.name: version
params.description: The version of the resource. At the moment, the only supported value is `latest`. When provided and the requested resource's `change_status` is pending, the resource will be returned with all pending changes applied. When no changes are pending the resource is returned as is. The `change_status` in the response body will reflect the current state of the resource.
